en.headline: Salt-water pipe bursts near Sai Ying Pun market, roads closed
en.dek: A salt-water main ruptured outside the Second Street market on Friday morning, sending a three-metre jet of muddy water onto the carriageway and forcing temporary closures.
body: A salt-water pipe burst outside the market at Second Street in Sai Ying Pun on Friday morning, spraying water up to three metres high and flooding sections of the road with muddy water mixed with sand.

The Water Supplies Department said the rupture occurred at about 8.50am near the junction of Second Street and Centre Street. Police closed part of the carriageway while engineers shut off the valve and began emergency repairs. The Transport Department advised drivers that the section of Centre Street between First Street and Second Street was closed to traffic.

Muddy water flowed down the slope towards Queen's Road West. Pedestrians had to pick their way through shallow floodwater during the morning rush hour. Care teams from the Central and Western District assisted elderly residents with wheelchairs at the scene.
No injuries were reported. Repair work was still under way later in the morning, and the department urged the public to stay clear of the works area.

zh.headline: 西營盤正街街市外鹹水管爆裂 部分路面封閉
zh.dek: 周五早上第二街正街街市對開鹹水管爆裂，水柱一度高達三米，泥水湧出路面，警方封閉部分行車線。
body: 西營盤第二街正街街市對開周五早上發生鹹水管爆裂，水柱一度噴至約三米高，大量泥水夾雜沙石湧出路面，沿斜路流向皇后大道西。
水務署表示，水管約上午8時50分在第二街與正街交界附近爆裂。警方到場封閉部分行車線，水務署人員關掉水掣展開緊急維修。運輸署宣布正街介乎第一街與第二街一段行車線暫時封閉，駕駛人士需改用其他道路。
途人於上班繁忙時間須涉水而行。中西區關愛隊到場協助使用輪椅的長者進出。
事件中無人受傷。維修工作上午稍後仍在進行，水務署呼籲市民勿走近工程範圍。
